Audio, particles and 2D/3D presentation cues

Make accepted actions readable without allowing particles, sprite frames or sounds to grant damage, resources or loot. A missed cue may look wrong but must never leave gameplay stuck.

Scope and player interaction

Make accepted actions readable without allowing particles, sprite frames or sounds to grant damage, resources or loot. A missed cue may look wrong but must never leave gameplay stuck.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase07committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unloaded → Ready → PredictedCue → ConfirmedCue → CanceledCue → Suppressed

WBP_Options observes results from URPGPresentationCueComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_CueSet_Common. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
CueId: stable cosmetic catalog key
ActionId and ServerStartTime: visual correlation, not reward credentials
AttachmentAnchor: Feet|HandMain|HandOff|WorldPoint; offsets per facing
SoundVolume: local 0..1 master/music/effects/voice sliders
ReducedFlash and MotionReduction: local accessibility flags
MaxConcurrentCues: per client budget; suppress lowest priority first

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGPresentationCueComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_OptionsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
PlayLocalCue(CueId, ActionId, Anchor) -> CueHandle|MissingCue; cosmetic custom API
ConfirmCue(ActionId, ServerTime) -> Reconciled|AlreadyConfirmed
CancelCue(ActionId) -> Stopped|AlreadyGone
ApplyAudioSettings(SettingsRevision) -> Applied; local only

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Input may start an inexpensive predicted swing cue with its local action correlation.
  2. Server accepts or rejects the action using combat/gathering rules independently of the cue.
  3. Accepted presentation state includes action identity, target/world point and start time; remote clients resolve the authored cue.
  4. The cue adapter samples the current facing anchor, spawns world-space projectile/impact particles or plays sound, and avoids triggering twice when prediction is confirmed.
  5. Rejected action fades/cancels the predicted cue; late remote presentation catches up within a bounded visual window.
  6. Destroy or pool visual components on completion, possession change and zone unload; no cue callback calls a reward or health setter.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_CueSet_Common with mappings for Cleave, ArrowImpact, OreHit, WoodHit, FishBite, CraftComplete and LevelUp; rights-cleared sound/VFX assignments remain explicit authoring tasks.
  2. Create Niagara systems only after checking the installed Niagara tooling; use engine primitive debug circles and text markers until assets exist. Do not treat a particle collision event as a server hit.
  3. Attach URPGPresentationCueComponent to the player/enemy presentation root; define foot and hand offsets in DA_AnimationSet_Common per facing/page.
  4. Bind audio sliders in WBP_Options to local audio settings, not replicated attributes. Include mute, subtitle/visual cue toggles and reduced-flash controls.
  5. Place CueEmitter_A in L_ArtLab and trigger each cue from the diagnostics adapter with no gameplay state changes; repeat during a two-client combat run.

Reopen Phase07 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_ArtLab / CueEmitter_A / two remote clients. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Missing cue asset -> one rate-limited MissingCue warning; gameplay still completes.
Late confirm for canceled action -> no second sound/particle and no gameplay grant.
Zone unload while particle alive -> destroy/pool safely, no stale Actor dereference.
Muted audio -> fishing bite still has a readable visual timer.
Packet loss drops cosmetic cue -> health/loot state remains correct through replicated snapshots.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed 32 nearby important cues and 16 ambient looping voices per client are profiling hypotheses, not measured budgets. Disable costly shadowed translucent particles on low settings.

Log missing cue IDs once per catalog version, pooled component counts and rendering/audio cost. Never encode critical telegraphs only in sound or color.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
